name: Eelgrass tuft
lore: Long ribbons that lean with every swell.
reference: Zostera marina tuft: 8-10 long, very narrow ribbon blades (~1 cm wide) rising from a small sand mound, leaning out and arching over at the tips; grass green at the base to yellow-green tips with pale epiphyte speckle

sway.personality: long ribbons lean with the current and arch over, tips trailing the base, a slow even breathing sway

sit.why: seagrass grows straight up toward the light from its rooted base, whatever the slope
